messages:
hiro: Heads-up: Pelican v2 q8_m bringup (onboard candidate) shows a small but consistent locale-specific failure mixing Simplified CJK and RTL Arabic fragments. Not pure tokenizationit's joining tokens across NBSP/ZWSP boundaries and flipping bracket orientation in the target.
dana: can you share a minimal repro and the metric deltas?
hiro: pasted below. Summary first: chrF++ and BLEU both drop on mixed locale slice. Baseline fp16 chrF=0.612 / BLEU=30.9; q8_m chrF=0.591 / BLEU=29.1. COMET also -0.03. Regression concentrated on short-subtitle lines with NBSP between han characters and Arabic word, and also lines with trailing "." inside fullwidth bracket.
chen: interesting. tokenizer change during quant? we didn't change the merge table for pelican, right?
kevin: no, we kept merges identical. q8_m export did a vocab index remap to compress unused ids (gap compaction) -- that could cause token id reuse in the runtime-side mapping if we messed up the mapping table.
ops-bot: CI smoke triggered: pelican-q8-microbatch-smoke (run id: 8829).
hiro: minimal example (note: 0xA0 used to show NBSP):
```
INPUT: "\u5e02\u4e2d\u00A0\u06274\u062f\u0627\u0645\uff0e"
FP16_OUT: "\u5e02\u4e2d \u06274224\u3002"
Q8_M_OUT: "\u5e02\u4e2d\u0627\u00A0\u0627\u00064)\uff0e"
```
hiro: (above is mangled because token boundaries glued CJK and Arabic and ')' replaced fullwidth bracket, orientation wrong).
dana: can eval-bot run a slice and produce token-id diff map between fp16 and q8_m outputs? Also sample-level attentions would help to see if kv cache indexing drifted.
eval-bot: Running diff slice: poly-subtitles-mixed-locale (n=4,019).
eval-bot: Automated summary: fp16 chrF=0.612 -> q8_m chrF=0.591 (delta -0.021); BLEU 30.9 -> 29.1 (delta -1.8); COMET 0.845 -> 0.815 (delta -0.03). Concentration: 286 examples where NBSP present at CJK-RTL boundary; 167 examples with ZWJ/combining marks nearby. Top token-id mismatches: indices [9051, 9052] show collisions after index compaction in runtime mapping.
chen: ok that points at runtime id remap bug. kevin, can you check the compact-mapping table produced during export?
kevin: will do. Also propose a mitigation: for the short term, add a safelist of grapheme clusters for NBSP, ZWSP, and ZWJ to prevent compaction. Longer term, fix the compaction to maintain stable id assignments for grapheme clusters used by tokenizer.
hiro: good plan. we should also add a locale-mix smoke (CJK+RTL+combining) to the genqa onboarding checklist so this doesn't slip.
dana: agreed. Also let's revert the q8_m rollout to canary and block full onboard in Dedicated until we have a patch. Tagging sales/customer-scs.
kevin: I'll post a diff of the mapping table in ~30m.
eval-bot: Saved detailed per-sample diffs to the onboarding bucket: s3://redwood-inference-onboard/pelican-v2/q8_m/diffs/8829.json
hiro: thanks everyone. follow-ups: kevin verify mapping; ops add locale-mix smoke case; chen coordinate rollback for canary.
ops-bot: Action items created: OPS-9934 (canary rollback), ML-1220 (mapping fix), QA-4477 (locale-mix smoke).
